label: terrestrial primary production
definition: An autotrophic process during which living entities fix inorganic carbon and generate biomass in terrestrial biomes.

label: marine primary production
definition: An autotrophic process during which living entities fix inorganic carbon and generate biomass in marine environments.
exact_synonym: marine net primary production|oceanic primary production

label: benthic primary production
definition: An autotrophic process during which living entities fix inorganic carbon and generate biomass in benthic zones.
